title: Emotes: 31 of them, with real music
summary: Dances with music on the beat, trolls, celebrations and seasonal specials - every emote with its own effects, sounds and 3D props. Everyone with Velo sees and hears them.

blocks.text: Hold B. Pick one. Let it play.

Emotes are in the **Velo Store** now - **31** at launch. Hold **B** in game for your emote wheel, point at one and let go (or press 1-8). Arrange your wheel in the Locker's Emotes tab. Other Velo players **see and hear** your emotes, and you theirs.

The dances play actual music, and the moves are **timed to the beat** - the dance is stretched to the track's tempo and its hits land on the drums, so it stays in sync for as long as you keep dancing.

items: **Floss**, **Griddy**, **Shuffle**, **Y.M.C.A.** (the letters light up above you), **Hip Hop** and **Breakdance** with a boombox next to you
**Silly Dance** and **Groove**, now with music too
**Take the L** - an L on your forehead, for every player you just beat

blocks.text: No vanilla particles: confetti, shockwave rings, lightning, hand trails, ghosts, bats, snow, hearts and floating letters - drawn like our auras. Every sound is made for Velo too.

blocks.caption: Some emotes bring props: a boombox, a trophy, a teacup, an air horn, a tombstone...

items: **Trolls**: Air Horn, Sips Tea, AFK (nod off to elevator music), Facepalm
**Celebrations**: Victory (a golden trophy rises), Thunder Slam, Backflip, Goal!
**Halloween** (Afterlife collection): Grave Rise, Trick or Treat, Ghost Party
**Winter** (Yuletide collection): Snowball Fight, Surprise Gift, Jingle Jam with a Santa hat
**Classics**, reworked: Wave, Cheer, Bow, Flex, Heart, Shrug, Rage and a brand-new No No

blocks.text: Too loud? Mods > Emotes lets you set the emote volume, the music volume and how loud other players' emotes are - or turn music, sounds or effects off.
Try every emote on your own skin on velo-client.com/store - with its music.
